desc: Left-handed shooters and anyone who switches shoulders will want this one. It puts QD sling sockets on both sides, so your sling attaches where it makes sense for how you’re running the gun. The plate is made from 4130 heat-treated steel, which is stronger than standard stamping and stands up to sling loads. Manganese phosphate finish keeps rust off. It works with AR-15, M4, and M16 platform rifles and installs like any standard end plate.
